turns.question: What was our ROAS in September 2026, counting the value of bookings against ad spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ROAS (return on ad spend) metric, so I can't give that ratio; the closest metrics are Booking value (EUR), Ad spend (EUR) and Cost per booking (EUR), and for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 booking value was 128,900.00 EUR and ad spend was 6,270.00 EUR. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
